Welcome to Confess
Say what you can\'t say anywhere else. Only your alias and aura are ever shown.
Here\'s a quick look at what you can do
Swipe or tap Next. Skip any time
What\'s new
A few things arrived since you last looked around.
More than words
Every confession can carry a little extra.
A mood tells people how to respond
Polls with anonymous votes that are final
Unsent letters, addressed \"To: …\"
Say it with a GIF
Pick a GIF from GIPHY for a confession or a response.
Tap GIF next to Unsent letter and Poll
A GIF confession says up to 100 characters
Respond with words, a GIF, or both
Feel it
Let someone know their words landed.
Tap to feel it, double-tap a card for a quick ❤️
Hold and slide to pick 🫂 🤝 💪 🥺
Respond, or keep it to reactions with \"Just listen\"
Stories for a day
A short thought that disappears after 24 hours.
A glowing ring means there\'s something new
See who read yours
Follow the voices you like
Keep up with the people whose words stay with you.
A Following feed, just for them
Hear when they confess
Tell it in chapters
Some stories need more room. Books give it to them.
Write chapters and schedule when they come out
Read like an e-book, with your own fonts and themes
Save books to read with no signal
A lot to say?
When someone posts several confessions in a row, they read as one.
Read from the first, the way it was written
Choose slider, stack or one by one in Appearance
Gentle with heavy things
Confessions that might be hard to read are blurred until you tap them.
You choose when you\'re ready
Report or block anyone, any time
Make it yours
Confess can look and feel the way you like.
Arrange the bottom bar and your Me page
Text size, spacing and 8 fonts for confessions and books
Paper tone, from bright to charcoal
Confess sounds
Eight notification sounds made for Confess.
Tap one to hear it before you choose
Settings → Notifications → Notification sound
Locked to everyone else
Your confessions stay yours on this phone.
A password lock, with fingerprint unlock
Shake your phone to lock Confess at once
